prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp, 16:10 landscape, first viewport plus a visible beginning of the second section
Primary request: Design a bold, production-grade homepage comp for the Brazilian ecommerce brand "Medicina Sagrada" using the visual world "Caixas de Origem", translating a wall of carefully labeled archive and shipping boxes into a tactile ecommerce interface. This is a persuasive website, not packaging artwork or a moodboard.
Structure: a slim header with the Medicina Sagrada brand name, navigation "Rapé", "Sananga", "Artesanato", "Etnias", "Nossa história", search and cart; the hero is an asymmetric wall of large interlocking colored modules like box ends and open drawers. One large open module contains a documentary Amazon landscape and neutral unlabeled rapé product still-life; another carries the offer and a vivid orange catalog CTA; smaller modules show category labels and provenance fields. The lower edge reveals seven circular ethnicity access points labeled "Huni Kuin", "Shawãdawa", "Kuntanawa", "Nukini", "Yawanawa", "Apurinã", "Shanenawa", plus a narrow right-side shortcut "VER TODAS AS ETNIAS →".
Exact hero text: "Medicinas indígenas originais, direto da floresta."
Exact supporting text: "Produtos de diferentes povos, com histórias de origem."
Exact CTA: "ENTRAR NO CATÁLOGO"
Visual system: modular archive boxes, end labels, lot stamps, tissue-paper reveals and clear commerce indexing; tactile and contemporary rather than warehouse-industrial.
Palette: committed box fields in #17401D deep green, #248C34 bright green, #EF492B orange and #A3250F deep red, with #F4F0E6 for label paper and breathing room.
Typography: distinctive condensed caps for labels plus a sturdy contemporary sans for the main message; no high-contrast serif.
Composition: clear purchase hierarchy, one dominant open module, varied block scale, products and origin visible immediately, no generic centered hero and no ordinary card grid.
Image ethics: do not invent Indigenous portraits, body paint, clothing, symbols, or tribal patterns. The circular access points show abstract documentary placeholders of landscape, tools, wood, fiber and craft details only, later replaced with real authorized photos. Do not objectify people.
Constraints: no fabricated reviews, prices, certifications, badges, health claims, discounts, or impact numbers. No sneaker imagery, fashion branding, mystical smoke, mandalas, generic leaf logos, gold luxury styling, beige wellness template, glassmorphism, gradients, watermarks, browser chrome, or device frame. Render as a polished website screen with crisp UI text.
